edits.text: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production
PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production.
1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material, work product, or information not proportional to the needs of the case.
2. PRODUCTION. Subject to objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents in its possession, custody, or control.
3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on privilege grounds, if any, will be identified in an appropriate privilege log.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend, supplement, or modify this response as appropriate.

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production. Defendant’s responses below are made subject to the General Objections set forth herein, and, to the extent not specifically objected to, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents within its possession, custody, or control.

1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected by the attorney-client privilege, attorney work-product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or immunity. Defendant further objects to each request to the extent it is overly broad, unduly burdensome, seeks information not proportional to the needs of the case, or seeks documents not relevant to any claim or defense. Defendant does not waive these objections by producing any documents or by stating that it may produce documents responsive to a request.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents in its possession, custody, or control. To the extent any responsive documents are withheld, they are withheld only on the basis of a stated objection, including privilege or work-product protection, and Defendant will identify any such withheld materials in its privilege log as required by the applicable rules. Production will begin on a rolling basis beginning promptly after service of this supplemental response.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Any documents withheld on privilege or work-product grounds, if any, will be identified in a privilege log served on a rolling basis, together with sufficient information to assess the basis for the withholding.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend, supplement, or modify these responses as discovery proceeds and additional information becomes available.

partner.private_reasoning: No confidential rent figure or other protected client-specific information appears in the rendered text or cover note. No hidden-content concerns are present.

receiver.message_back: Thank you for the clarification. Please confirm that Defendant will not rely on the boilerplate general objections to withhold responsive non-privileged materials, and that any privilege log will be served on a rolling basis with sufficient detail to permit assessment of the asserted privilege.
